notes: Stored edit (a dolphin's class, in_class: functional). The subject is the dolphin as a kind, treated as one individual of the ontology: its class applies to every dolphin, which is why Flipper (an individual) inherits it. Related near is the functional exclusion (not a mammal); related far applies the class rule that a cartilaginous fish is a fish, against the stored 'dolphins are not fish'. Derived: composition (the same class as the great white shark and as the stingray) and inheritance (Flipper, a dolphin). Every determinate query asks about a class or an individual member, never about a trait of dolphins that models store by name (skeleton, breathing, nursing), because those split by storage. The one indeterminate query is breathing (background beliefs): stored about dolphins by name they breathe air with lungs, stored through the class they would breathe with gills. It replaces the nursing query (its 'no' world was not credible) and the skeleton and gills queries labelled determinate, which had the same by-name route. Counts are exact-phrase counts in Dolma (v4_dolma-v1_7_llama).
